label: Documentation
description: Source-backed documentation with runnable examples and link validation.

assignments.lead: Documentation lead — verify behavior from source, update the smallest relevant docs, validate examples, and commit.
assignments.reviewer: Reviewer — check accuracy, audience fit, terminology, and omissions independently. Do not edit the lead's files.
assignments.verifier: Verifier — run documented commands or examples and check links independently.

required_evidence: Claims traced to source or executable behavior
